body: {"better": "B", "reason": "Card A says 'ఎక్కండి' (you board) which incorrectly implies father boards alone; Card B uses 'ఎక్కండి' same way but 'వరకు నడిచి' is clearer. However, Card A's 'అందరితో కలిసి' (with everyone) slightly overstates 'small, friendly group' as 'everyone.' Card B's 'స్వచ్ఛందంగా' (voluntarily/freely) is unsupported. Both have minor issues, but Card A's 'అందరితో' is a clearer unsupported addition; Card B's 'స్వచ్ఛందంగా' is closer to 'friendly' tone. Actually re-reading: Card A's 'అందరితో కలిసి చిన్నగా' combines unsupported 'with everyone' and misrepresents 'small group' as 'quietly/chinnaaga.' Card B is cleaner in description. Both ~45 words. Card B better."}
